hints.title: Partitioning Array by Window Spans
hints.text: Segmenting a list into consecutive chunks of maximum length size requires advancing a step index by size across the array.

hints.title: Step Slicing Loop
hints.text: Iterate index i from zero to array length stepping by size. Extract subarray slice from i to i + size and append to the result container.

hints.title: Chunk Loop Blueprint
hints.text: Initialize chunks = []. For (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += size) { chunks.push(arr.slice(i, i + size)); } Return chunks.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Slices and shallow-copies each element into a subarray exactly once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pushing individual elements with conditional index checks incurs extra branch evaluations compared to slice.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pre-chunking creates a 2D array representation in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct handling of the trailing chunk when array length is not evenly divisible by size.
